using System;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Database;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.FullSystemBackup;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Tests.FullSystemBackup
{
    public class BackupServiceTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<BackupService>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _dbProviderMock;
        private readonly BackupService _backupService;

        public BackupServiceTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<BackupService>>();
            _dbProviderMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();

            // Create minimal mocks for other dependencies
            var applicationHostMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();
            var applicationPathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var jellyfinDatabaseProviderMock = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            var applicationLifetimeMock = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();

            _backupService = new BackupService(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                applicationHostMock.Object,
                applicationPathsMock.Object,
                jellyfinDatabaseProviderMock.Object,
                applicationLifetimeMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RestoreBackupAsync_MissingZipEntryForTable_LogsInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var archivePath = "test.zip";
            var zipStreamMock = new Mock<Stream>();
            zipStreamMock.Setup(s => s.Dispose()).Verifiable();

            var fileStreamMock = new Mock<FileStream>(archivePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
            fileStreamMock.Setup(f => f.Dispose()).Verifiable();

            var zipArchiveMock = new Mock<ZipArchive>(fileStreamMock.Object, ZipArchiveMode.Read, false);
            zipArchiveMock.Setup(z => z.Dispose()).Verifiable();

            // Mock manifest entry to pass initial validation
            var manifestEntryMock = new Mock<ZipArchiveEntry>();
            zipArchiveMock.Setup(z => z.GetEntry("manifest.json")).Returns(manifestEntryMock.Object);
            var manifestStreamMock = new Mock<Stream>();
            manifestEntryMock.Setup(e => e.OpenAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())).ReturnsAsync(manifestStreamMock.Object);

            // Setup entity types reflection (mock the scenario where we reach the logging line)
            var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>(new DbContextOptionsBuilder<JellyfinDbContext>().Options);
            _dbProviderMock.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync()).ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);

            // Mock GetEntry to return null for the specific table (triggers the LogInformation at line ~211)
            zipArchiveMock.Setup(z => z.GetEntry(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns((ZipArchiveEntry)null);

            // Mock File.OpenRead to return our controlled stream
            Mock.Arrange(() => File.OpenRead(archivePath)).Returns(fileStreamMock.Object);

            // Act
            var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath));

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("No backup of expected table") && t.ToString().Contains("Table")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify streams were properly disposed
            zipStreamMock.Verify(s => s.Dispose(), Times.Once);
            fileStreamMock.Verify(f => f.Dispose(), Times.Once);
            zipArchiveMock.Verify(z => z.Dispose(), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void RestoreBackupAsync_FileDoesNotExist_ThrowsFileNotFoundException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var archivePath = "nonexistent.zip";
            Mock.Arrange(() => File.Exists(archivePath)).Returns(false);

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<FileNotFoundException>(() => _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath));
            
            // Verify no logger calls for the missing table scenario
            _loggerMock.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }
    }
}

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Tests.FullSystemBackup
{
    public class BackupServiceTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<BackupService>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<DbContext>> _dbProviderMock;
        private readonly BackupService _backupService;

        public BackupServiceTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<BackupService>>();
            _dbProviderMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<DbContext>>();

            var applicationHostMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();
            applicationHostMock.Setup(h => h.ApplicationVersion).Returns(new Version(10, 8, 0));
            
            var applicationPathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var jellyfinDatabaseProviderMock = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            var applicationLifetimeMock = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();

            _backupService = new BackupService(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                applicationHostMock.Object,
                applicationPathsMock.Object,
                jellyfinDatabaseProviderMock.Object,
                applicationLifetimeMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RestoreBackupAsync_MissingZipEntryForTable_LogsNoBackupMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var archivePath = "test.zip";
            
            // Mock static File.Exists
            Mock.Get(File).Setup(f => f.Exists(archivePath)).Returns(true);
            
            // Mock File.OpenRead
            var fileStream = new MemoryStream();
            Mock.Get(File).Setup(f => f.OpenRead(archivePath)).Returns(fileStream);
            
            // Create real ZipArchive but control entries
            using var zipArchive = new ZipArchive(fileStream, ZipArchiveMode.Create, leaveOpen: true);
            
            // Add manifest entry to pass validation
            var manifestEntry = zipArchive.CreateEntry("manifest.json");
            using var manifestStream = manifestEntry.Open();
            var manifest = new BackupManifest 
            { 
                ServerVersion = new Version(10, 7, 0),
                BackupEngineVersion = new Version(0, 2, 0),
                Options = new BackupOptions { Database = true }
            };
            await JsonSerializer.SerializeAsync(manifestStream, manifest);
            
            // Mock DbContext creation (database restore path)
            var dbContextMock = new Mock<DbContext>();
            _dbProviderMock.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                          .ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);
            
            // Mock database operations to complete without error
            var databaseMock = new Mock<DatabaseFacade>(dbContextMock.Object);
            dbContextMock.Setup(c => c.Database).Returns(databaseMock.Object);
            databaseMock.Setup(d => d.ExecuteSqlRawAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                       .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            
            // Mock PurgeDatabase
            var jellyfinDbProviderMock = Mock.Get(_backupService as BackupService).Setup(x => x._jellyfinDatabaseProvider);
            jellyfinDbProviderMock.Setup(p => p.PurgeDatabase(It.IsAny<DbContext>(), It.IsAny<IEnumerable<string>>()))
                                 .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
            
            fileStream.Position = 0; // Reset stream for reading
            
            // Mock File.OpenRead to return positioned stream
            Mock.Get(File).Setup(f => f.OpenRead(archivePath)).Returns(() => 
            {
                fileStream.Position = 0;
                return fileStream;
            });

            // Act
            await _backupService.RestoreBackupAsync(archivePath);

            // Assert - verify the specific LogInformation call at line 211
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => 
                        t.ToString().Contains("No backup of expected table {Table}") &&
                        t.ToString().Contains("is present in backup, continuing anyway")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}
